name: DR Congo (east)
value: Masisi clashes; villages retaken; no city falls
summary: Congolese forces retake villages in Masisi from 3 Nov as fighting continues near Walikale; no major city changes hands
state: Congolese forces and Wazalendo fighters attacked FRN/M23 positions in Masisi from 3 Nov and retook villages including Mirindano, Mahanga and Kilongo; civil and security sources gave a provisional toll of at least four civilians killed (Radio Okapi; Congo Quotidien). Fighting intensified on the Kashebere–Kibati axis on 5 Nov, with Kibati still held by the rebels (Radio Okapi, 6 Nov). Searches on 8 Nov found no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting.
for_you: Civilians in Masisi and Walikale are most exposed, with mass displacement, limited aid access and road traffic suspended on the Kashebere–Kibati axis. Renewed fighting also tends to complicate health responses in eastern DR Congo.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting in North Kivu from 3 Nov. Alert line (capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting) not met as of 8 Nov.
